svg.metadata: {"id": "s031", "name": "数学黑板", "cat": "数学", "tags": ["数学", "几何", "数轴", "通用课堂"], "desc": "数学课黑板：粉笔画出直角三角形、圆与半径、面积方格和 0–10 数轴；墙上挂三角板、量角器、圆规，右侧有算盘。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [600, 1320]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "board", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "chalk", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "tools", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "compass", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.7, "loop": "swing", "depth": null}, {"name": "abacus", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "podium", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.85, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "dust", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}, {"name": "light", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#E7F4EF", "wall2": "#CFE8DF", "board": "#2C5466", "board2": "#244657", "frame": "#C99462", "frame2": "#A6723F", "chalk": "#FFFFFF", "cy": "#FFE08A", "cb": "#9FE3FF", "cp": "#FFB3C1", "cg": "#B8F0B0", "wains": "#9CCBB9", "wains2": "#7FB5A2", "floor1": "#D8B58C", "floor2": "#C29A6C", "tri": "#F7C55E", "tri2": "#E9A93A", "prot": "#7FC4E8", "bead": "#E8705A", "bead2": "#F2B33D", "wood": "#B57A4A", "wood2": "#8A5833", "leaf": "#6DB585", "leaf2": "#A6D99A", "pot": "#F2836B", "paper": "#FFFDF6"}}
